components.purpose: Opening section: event title (Heading field) and a 'Register Now' CTA button (cta1 Link field), displayed over a color gradient background (backgroundType field, e.g. yellow-pink/green-blue-yellow).
Short free-text agenda section listing the webinar schedule/session breakdown.
Registration form for sign-ups, with configurable submit button, success/error messaging, and webhook/email delivery of registrant data.
